$comment: Single source of truth for the pinned Bun runtime everywhere in this repository: root/Feed/template packageManager, every workflow's bun-version/BUN_VERSION wiring, the setup-bun-workspace composite default, and the bun.sh/install shell installs on deploy hosts. Floating `canary`/`latest` reserializes bun.lock to lockfileVersion 2 and breaks `bun install --frozen-lockfile` (#11184/#9454), and unpublished versions 404 during setup (#17044) — so every authoritative install path pins the concrete version here. GitHub Actions cannot interpolate a file into `${{ }}` at parse time, so the literal is repeated at each site and packages/scripts/ci-bun-version-contract.mjs is what guarantees the copies never drift: it scans every workflow, composite action, packageManager declaration, root Bun type anchor, and bun.sh/install line, and fails the branch on any floating, mutable, implicit, or divergent value. To bump: change `version` here and update every enforced literal in the SAME PR — the contract names each stale site.
